preview.what: useEffect done right: dependencies, cleanup, and race conditions with async data.
preview.picture: Ordering two coffees, the second arriving first, and you drinking the wrong one — that is an effect race. Cleanup is cancelling the first order.
preview.why: The single most common React senior screen question.
preview.bn: দুটো কফি order, দ্বিতীয়টা আগে এল, ভুলটা খেলে — এটাই effect race; cleanup = প্রথম order বাতিল।
